# FactWise

> FactWise connects every vendor workflow including Inquiry to Quote, Requisition to PO and Invoice to Pay.

FactWise is a comprehensive, modular procurement platform designed to replace fragmented legacy systems and spreadsheets, driving sourcing savings and accelerating the entire procurement lifecycle.

## Core Workflows
- [Inquiry to Quote](https://factwise.io/inquiry-to-quote): Streamline your RFQ and quotation process.
- [Requisition to PO](https://factwise.io/requisitions-to-po): Manage purchase requisitions and purchase orders seamlessly.
- [Invoice to Pay](https://factwise.io/invoice-to-pay): Automate invoice processing and vendor payments.
